newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S MERSON OUT FOR SIX WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARSENAL'S MERSON OUT FOR SIX WEEKS.

text.p: Arsenal's England midfielder Paul Merson will be sidelined for six weeks after undergoing a hernia operation on Thursday, the club said.
Merson, enjoying one of his best seasons with the Londoners, will miss most of the rest of the title run-in as well as England's friendly international against Mexico at Wembley on March 29.
He will hope to return for England's World Cup qualifier against Georgia on April 30.
